decisions.reason: Because it remained prominently listed through 2019 and fits the firm's core modular sensing platform, its performance likely met a satisfactory aspiration level for a niche but complementary module.
As a 3.0 replacement of an established voltage-measurement module that was still listed in 2019, it likely achieved acceptable results relative to prior generations and comparable core I/O products.

Its disappearance from the website by 2019 suggests results fell below aspiration quickly, so boundedly rational management would reallocate software and support resources to better-performing platform features or new developments.
The CAN bus interface was still offered in 2019 and is strongly aligned with German automation and embedded use cases, indicating satisfactory niche demand within the firm's platform.

The carbon dioxide sensor module kept its own page through 2019 and complements the firm's environmental sensing range, so management would likely tolerate and retain it if it performed at least adequately.
Its removal from the website by 2019 indicates weak traction versus aspiration, making it a plausible candidate for problemistic search and resource redeployment away from a peripheral accessory.
